# Complyd pipeline

> GitHub Action (and `complyd-pipeline` CLI for other CIs) that sends a dependency scan (OSV-Scanner JSON or SARIF), a SAST scan (SARIF from CodeQL, Semgrep) or AI eval results to Complyd, signed in with the workflow's OIDC token: no secrets.

Pin it as `uses: complyd/complyd-pipeline-action@a813c97d7b782498ef6daf680990822e0e8defb9 # v1.3.0` with `permissions: id-token: write`. The trust id comes from Complyd's Settings › Workload trusts.

## Docs

- [README.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/complyd/complyd-pipeline-action/main/README.md): the whole README as raw markdown
- [Set up with your AI assistant](https://github.com/complyd/complyd-pipeline-action/blob/main/README.md#set-up-with-your-ai-assistant): copy-paste prompt for coding assistants
- [Set up](https://github.com/complyd/complyd-pipeline-action/blob/main/README.md#set-up): dependency scan workflow with OSV-Scanner
- [SAST scans](https://github.com/complyd/complyd-pipeline-action/blob/main/README.md#sast-scans): CodeQL and Semgrep
- [AI release](https://github.com/complyd/complyd-pipeline-action/blob/main/README.md#ai-release): `scan: ai_eval` and `.complyd/ai.yml`
- [How a suite ran](https://github.com/complyd/complyd-pipeline-action/blob/main/README.md#how-a-suite-ran-execution): `execution: live | scripted | replay` per suite in `.complyd/ai.yml` (from v1.4.0: not while the pin above is v1.3.0, which refuses the key); leave it out when unknown, never mark a scripted suite `live`
- [Model usage](https://github.com/complyd/complyd-pipeline-action/blob/main/README.md#model-usage): (from v1.4.0) calls, tokens and cost the eval tool reported, per format
- [Generic format](https://github.com/complyd/complyd-pipeline-action/blob/main/README.md#generic-format): JSON for any other harness, with optional `execution` and `usage` (from v1.4.0)
- [Inputs](https://github.com/complyd/complyd-pipeline-action/blob/main/README.md#inputs): every input and output
- [What Complyd receives](https://github.com/complyd/complyd-pipeline-action/blob/main/README.md#what-complyd-receives): exactly what is sent
- [Errors](https://github.com/complyd/complyd-pipeline-action/blob/main/README.md#errors): failure messages and fixes
- [action.yml](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/complyd/complyd-pipeline-action/main/action.yml): the action's inputs, authoritative
- [SECURITY.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/complyd/complyd-pipeline-action/main/SECURITY.md): security policy and data handling

## Examples

- [GitHub Actions: dependency scan](https://github.com/complyd/complyd-pipeline-action/blob/main/README.md#set-up)
- [GitHub Actions: CodeQL SAST](https://github.com/complyd/complyd-pipeline-action/blob/main/README.md#sast-scans)
- [GitHub Actions: promptfoo eval](https://github.com/complyd/complyd-pipeline-action/blob/main/README.md#github-actions)
- [GitLab CI](https://github.com/complyd/complyd-pipeline-action/blob/main/README.md#gitlab-ci), [CircleCI](https://github.com/complyd/complyd-pipeline-action/blob/main/README.md#circleci), [Bitbucket Pipelines](https://github.com/complyd/complyd-pipeline-action/blob/main/README.md#bitbucket-pipelines), [Jenkins](https://github.com/complyd/complyd-pipeline-action/blob/main/README.md#jenkins), [AWS CodeBuild](https://github.com/complyd/complyd-pipeline-action/blob/main/README.md#aws-codebuild), [Azure DevOps](https://github.com/complyd/complyd-pipeline-action/blob/main/README.md#azure-devops)
